title: Open PR options
description: Commit the staged files, if any, push, and open or update the pull request. Leave options unset to use the command defaults.

push.title: What to push
push.description: Commits ahead of the branch's upstream, or the whole branch with the PR seeded from every commit ahead of the default branch — for a branch already pushed without a PR.

target.title: Target
target.description: [remote/]base[:topic] for the PR and push, e.g. zim/main:feat/new-topic. Remote defaults to origin; topic defaults to the current branch. Leave blank for the default base.

auto-merge.title: Enable auto-merge
auto-merge.description: Let GitHub or Azure DevOps complete a newly opened PR once required checks and approvals pass. Applies only to new PRs.
